title: Refuse glob leases, reconcile terminal tool-path attempts, and preflight the feature branch at dispatch

outcome.summary: Three tool-path integrity gaps are closed without touching the durable job path. Dispatch refuses a lease that contains glob syntax with the named code lease_glob_unsupported before any launcher call or lease record, using the same validator the landing write-back uses. A new reconcile_tool_attempts sweep maps a launcher-terminal attempt (succeeded, failed, cancelled) onto the local attempt store even when the local row is still dispatched, and leaves a genuinely running attempt untouched; it never creates an attempt. Dispatch also preflights the local feature branch when a worktree is configured: it REFUSES a missing branch with branch_not_found and a branch that does not descend from source_rev with branch_diverged, and it never creates or moves a branch. The existing job-path reconcile tick is unchanged.
observable_behavior: a dispatch whose assigned_files contains '*', '?' or '[' returns ok:false, code lease_glob_unsupported, client.create is not called and no leases/<attempt>.json is written
bee_events.validate_lease_files accepts ordinary repository-relative paths including dots, plus signs, at-signs and subdirectories, and dispatch still creates exactly one attempt for them

reconcile.reconcile_tool_attempts(state_dir, backend) returns checked/reconciled/unchanged, writes succeeded as unverified, failed and cancelled as failed, leaves a running attempt dispatched, and calls backend.create zero times

dispatch with a configured worktree refuses a missing feature branch with branch_not_found and a non-descendant branch with branch_diverged before client.create; a branch equal to source_rev still dispatches
reconcile.tick on a durable job still performs exactly one dispatch, no verify, and no second post

assumptions: The local attempt store is the existing lease + tool-completion + verify evidence read by bundlebees_plugin.cli._attempt_rows; the sweep writes the same tool-completion record the polled write-back already writes, so no new store format is introduced.
The launcher backend exposes attempts_raw() (already used by tools._dispatch) and create(); the sweep reads attempts_raw() only and must never call create().

The feature branch is a local branch in the configured worktree (plugin setting worktree); dispatch does not fetch, create, move or push any branch, and skips the preflight when no worktree is configured.
bee_events is the single lease-path authority for both dispatch and landing events; the new public validate_lease_files is the shared entry point and _canonical_assigned_files delegates to it.
The RED base is origin/main a74287b44f0709dde7a8f298740813cfbbce8df6 and the frozen tests are exactly tests/test_toolpath_integrity.py.

interfaces.name: bundlebees_plugin/bee_events.py
interfaces.notes: Add public validate_lease_files(value) -> list[str]. It keeps every existing repository-relative rule and adds a glob refusal: any '*', '?' or '[' raises EventError('lease_glob_unsupported', ...). _canonical_assigned_files delegates to it so dispatch and the landing write-back share one decision.

interfaces.name: bundlebees_plugin/tools.py
interfaces.notes: _gate calls bee_events.validate_lease_files after brief validation and before the risk/contract gates, returning the named lease_glob_unsupported envelope. _dispatch preflights the local feature branch from args['_settings']['worktree'] before client.create: missing -> branch_not_found, not a descendant of source_rev -> branch_diverged; no git mutation.

interfaces.name: bundlebees_plugin/reconcile.py
interfaces.notes: Add reconcile_tool_attempts(state_dir, backend) -> dict with checked/reconciled/unchanged. It reads the local leases, matches each by attempt_id in backend.attempts_raw(), and for terminal states writes agent_consumer.record_tool_completion; non-terminal or absent launcher rows are unchanged. It never calls backend.create().

acceptance_criteria.statement: Dispatching a brief whose assigned_files contains any glob character (*, ? or [) is refused with the named code lease_glob_unsupported and nothing is recorded or dispatched: the launcher create is never called and no lease file exists.

The same lease validator (bee_events.validate_lease_files) still accepts an ordinary repository-relative path list, including paths with dots, plus signs, at-signs and subdirectories, and dispatch still creates exactly one attempt for that list.

reconcile.reconcile_tool_attempts(state_dir, backend) maps a launcher-terminal attempt (succeeded/failed/cancelled) onto the local attempt store even when the local row is still dispatched, leaves a genuinely running attempt untouched, and never calls backend.create(). The observed local states are unverified for succeeded, failed for failed and cancelled, and dispatched for running.

CHOSEN BEHAVIOUR: dispatch refuses, it never creates a branch. With a worktree configured, a feature branch that does not exist is refused with branch_not_found before any launcher call, and a feature branch that exists but does not descend from source_rev is refused with branch_diverged. A branch equal to or descending from source_rev still dispatches. Dispatch never creates, moves or pushes a branch.
The durable job path is unchanged: the existing reconcile.tick scenario still performs exactly one dispatch, never verifies on the dispatch tick, and never posts a second attempt.

reasons: bundlebees_plugin/tools.py is the dispatch gate every bee passes through
bundlebees_plugin/bee_events.py is the landing-event schema authority shared by the write-back and the outbox
bundlebees_plugin/reconcile.py is the crash-safety reconciler for durable jobs and the new tool-path sweep
a false accept here silently strands a dispatched attempt forever, which is the failure this slice closes
risk.blast_radius: every bundlebees dispatch, every tool-path terminal write-back, and the local attempt store view used by bundlebees status/attempts
